entities.title: Model Context Protocol
entities.summary: The protocol `afs serve` speaks to MCP clients.
entities.relevance: mcp.rs implements its stdio transport, initialize, ping, tools/list and tools/call, and defaults to protocol version 2024-11-05.

entities.title: Racy Git
entities.summary: Git's explanation of why a file modified in the same timestamp tick as its index entry cannot be trusted by its stat data.

entities.title: io_uring
entities.relevance: uring.rs batches openat, statx, read and close through it, linking statx before read with IOSQE_IO_LINK.

entities.title: POSIX lio_listio
entities.summary: The POSIX call that submits a list of asynchronous reads at once.
entities.relevance: aio.rs reads each batch of files on macOS with one lio_listio(LIO_WAIT), then checks each request with aio_error and aio_return.
